subject: RSeQC results to set -s parameter for featureCounts

messages.author: 107be3ec2cf742d7
messages.subject: RSeQC results to set -s parameter for featureCounts
parts:
I have RNAseq data from encode mouse and to do some analysis with cuffdiff and featureCounts I need first to understand what library type I have to chose the right parameters for featureCounts.

I ran infer_experiment.py from RSeQC and found out following configuration:
 This is SingleEnd Data
Fraction of reads failed to determine: 0.0023

Fraction of reads explained by "++,--": 0.0160

Fraction of reads explained by "+-,-+": 0.9817




For featureCounts I need to specify -s parameter. It would be -s2, is it correct?

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: RSeQC results to set -s parameter for featureCounts
parts:
I do not know what -s value you should use from the Rseqc output. But you may try all three different values (0, 1 and 2) to see which one gives you reasonable counting results. Each run should only take around a minute.

Cheers,
Wei

messages.author: 910e5c0430998601
messages.subject: Re: RSeQC results to set -s parameter for featureCounts
parts: You should use -s 2 the reversed library.
